slots.description: Ordered list of up to 12 RadioChannel ids shown as embedded listen-only radios on the public /radio monitor page. An empty string in a slot means that slot is unassigned. Always exactly 12 entries once saved (padded/truncated by the admin UI).

status_light_idle_color.description: Monitor grid status-dot color while a tile is idle/listening (connected, no one transmitting).

status_light_connecting_color.description: Monitor grid status-dot color while a tile is connecting or busy.

status_light_receiving_color.description: Monitor grid status-dot color while a tile is actively receiving (someone is transmitting).

status_light_error_color.description: Monitor grid status-dot color when a tile's connection errors out.

status_light_pulse.description: Whether the status dot pulses while connecting or receiving, instead of staying solid.

status_light_size.description: Size of the status dot on each monitor grid tile.
